description: This file contains unit tests for the DurableDictionary class, which is a persistent dictionary implementation using Orleans' journaling infrastructure. It includes tests for basic CRUD operations, persistence and recovery, handling of complex key and value types, clearing the dictionary, and enumeration capabilities.

classes.name: DurableDictionaryTests
classes.description: A collection of unit tests verifying the behavior of the DurableDictionary, including persistence, complex types handling, clearing, and enumeration.

classes.name: TestKey
classes.description: A custom key type with Id and Name properties, used to test complex key serialization in DurableDictionary.

methods.name: DurableDictionary_BasicOperations_Test
methods.description: Tests basic add, update, remove operations and indexer access on DurableDictionary.

methods.name: DurableDictionary_Persistence_Test
methods.description: Verifies that DurableDictionary correctly persists and recovers its state across restarts.

methods.name: DurableDictionary_ComplexKeys_Test
methods.description: Ensures that durable dictionaries can handle complex key objects properly.

methods.name: DurableDictionary_ComplexValues_Test
methods.description: Verifies that custom objects as values can be stored, retrieved, and mutated correctly.

methods.name: DurableDictionary_Clear_Test
methods.description: Tests the clear operation for the DurableDictionary and ensures proper journaling.

methods.name: DurableDictionary_Enumeration_Test
methods.description: Tests the ability to enumerate over the dictionary and access Keys and Values collections.
